text:
emily: Filed PR #678 for the relnotes + migration guide for SDK v0.14.0. Focus: runnable snippets (JS/Python), short migration blurb for model pinning, and two public known-issues. Please quick scan.

max: On it. JS snippet used legacy import; I'll paste minimal corrected snippet.

noor: I'll check the Python example and the changelog bullets.

max: JS fix: ```js
import { Client } from 'redwood'
const client = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
const r = await client.generate('hi')
console.log(r.output_text)
```
Ran locally.

noor: Python fix: ```python
import os
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.generate('hello')
print(resp.output_text)
```
Added missing os import in the note.

emily: Two relnotes edits: 1) changelog bullet for adaptive batching (be conservative); 2) public-friendly known-issue about embedding streaming truncating on some quantized models. Keep language simple.

max: Draft bullet: "Adaptive batching available via batching.policy=adaptive — can reduce per-token latency for short-chat workloads." Good?

noor: Looks fine. For the known-issue: "Embedding streaming may truncate on certain quantized models at token boundaries; workaround: use streaming.legacy_fallback or the non-quantized variant." Short and public.

emily: L10n flagged "fallback" wording. Use "fallback behavior" per localization note.

noor: Updated wording and swapped internal link to KB-9450.

ci-bot: Running snippet-verify and linkcheck on refs/heads/release/relnotes-678.

ci-bot: snippet-verify: JS/Python OK. linkcheck: 1 external 404 (third-party blog) detected.

max: Replaced with official spec link (https://spec.redwood.ai/pinning). Pushed.

ci-bot: linkcheck: all links 200. docs-lint: terminology nit about "rollback window" -> changed to "rollback plan".

emily: Plan: merge after editorial pass tomorrow morning if CI stays green. Add smoke-test CLI in PR comments: `redwoodctl smoke --scenario=short-chat --timeout=20s` expecting "{"status":"ok"}\`.

noor: Added smoke test + grep key check. I'll also add a tiny "what to watch" with two telemetry items. 

emily: Thanks team. Merge after editorial. :thumbsup:
